en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town built on a hillside along a wide river. The foreground shows the riverbank and water, while the middle ground is filled with dense traditional European houses and small church towers. On the ridge above the town stands a large building complex that looks like a villa or small palace, and to the far left a tall cylindrical tower rises above the wooded hill. At the bottom margin of the image, a caption in white script reads "Radebeul‑West, Friedensburg." The overall style and printing look like an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.
